title: The Cutting Edge: Week of May 31st
body:
## **Highlights**
- Market Across shared their [campaign report for the month of May 2021](https://share.coveragebook.com/b/ec804429a2e5ac05).
- Upcoming AMAs: [PicoSwap](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1138-introducing-picoswap-and-pico) and [AllianceBlock](https://blog.edgewa.re/allianceblock-announces-decentralized-capital-market-on-edgeware-with-unique-defi-nft-approach/).


## **Ecosystem Updates**
No major updates this week, just building.

## **Governance**
- The [treasury funding proposal by Zien.io](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1129-proposal-bring-zien-nfts-via-whatsapp-to-edgeware) for their social media-based NFT platform on Edgeware EVM is open for public voting through Referendum 42. {Referendum type: SuperMajorityApprove, Democracy Proposal ID:37, Treasury Proposal ID:32}
- Proposals in the pipeline: [How to make it in Crypto Media - an Original Podcast Series](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series), [Chico Crypto collaboration funding](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1232-chico-crypto-collaboration-funding), [New Futures](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1127-web30-dao-and-nft-launchpad-on-edgeware)


## **Community**
- ‘[Edgeware Culture & Values survey](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1170-edgeware-culture-values-survey-open-until-june-2nd)’ by Grant Dever got remarkable participation from several Edgeware community members.
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in,[ take a look.](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal)
- Trending Community Research thread(s):
- [Open Thread: What should Edgeware be focused on?](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1283-open-thread-what-should-edgeware-be-focused
